comparison.objective: Feed meat into a grinder using a pusher without entering the guarded throat; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires safe food placement, pusher grasping and downward force through a constrained opening. Candidate requires fine adjustment and locking with a small tool.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks two cubes passing the throat and permanent exclusion of robot links from the guarded volume. Candidate checks physical impact response and setting retention; response limits are incompletely specified.
comparison.reason: Guarded material feeding is unrelated to tuning a mechanical damper.
